calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — Teradyne as his blue-chip robotics play and first name to add to a robotics portfolio; great entry point on the pullback at a double/triple bottom. Semi testing drives growth, robotics/cobots are a cheap add-on with upside. No price stated.
calls.base_case: Earnings growth ~130% in 2026 and ~30% in following years; revenue growth ~61% this year on semi testing strength.
calls.bull_case: Robotics grows faster from a low base and could help Teradyne become a much larger — he says potential trillion-dollar — company; a 20-bagger in his framing.
